purpose: Repair unfair oracle-price versus maximum-event procurement comparison; mathematical framework only until empirical forecasts/grid/hardware validated
shared_inputs: Identical fixed jobs, rates, whole-power assumptions, deadlines and physical limits
Forecast marginal resource cost known at decision time
Same tariff outside option, immutable baseline and complete horizon including rebound
decision_separation: Planning function cannot receive realized costs; separate evaluator receives frozen schedules afterwards
event_procurement: Enumerate all explicitly offered nonnegative MW quantities including zero opt-out; choose greatest worst-tie forecast net resource saving; exact only within this offer set, not continuous-global optimal claim
follower: Minimize tariff plus service cost for each commitment; bound all epsilon-optimal follower choices with best/worst forecast resource objective
price: Posted exogenous forecast marginal-cost signal; not a dual from a realized coordinated solution; optimality is a linear-price mathematical benchmark, not deployment evidence
accounting: Report physical resource savings, retailer cash and provider welfare separately; minimum weak-participation transfer; transfer cancellation identity required
recovery: Explicit optional aggregate non-event energy bound relative to fixed outside option; no work dropping or deadline repair
tests: Analytic interior procurement beating maximum response
Tie cases with opposite grid benefits
Planning invariance to realized evaluation values
Exhaustive small integer assignment oracles with all commitment choices
exclusions: No market equilibrium, strategic bidding or baseline manipulation equilibrium
No new empirical model parameter fit
